messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty page fired for inference-prod-high-latency (PD# P12345). Trigger: 90th percentile latency > 1.5s for 10m. Link: https://pagerduty.com/incidents/P12345

bob: acked — I'm on it.

alice: grabbing a bridge and starting triage. @bob are you seeing increased error rates or just tail latency?

bob: just tail latency on inferenceroutes, error rate is flat. No deploys in the last 30m per deploybot.

carol: spotting a spike in requests from customer-47 (EU region) at ~1719809600, their logs show request timeouts. Support ticket #5522 opened.

dana: on it from CS side — contacting customer lead to notify them we're investigating, ETA 10m.

evans: quick telemetry check — KV cache miss rate jumped ~3x around 1719809600 and per-shard queue depth rose briefly. Sending logs to the bridge.

alice: following runbook: step 1 scale dedicated inference pool +2 GPUs, step 2 enable routing fallback to smaller-model-quant for burst. Kicking off scale now.

incident-bot: autoscaler: scale request submitted (req id req-9876).

bob: scale applied, dedicated-pool-42 +2 gpus. Also applied routing fallback to cost-tier-fallback policy. Monitoring.

alice: initial numbers: p90 latency dropped 1.6s -> 0.9s after scale/fallback. Continuing 10m observation window. :thumbsup:

carol: customer confirms via ticket they no longer see timeouts, reported degraded UX but no data loss.

dana: relayed status to customer; they'll re-open if issues recur.

bob: leaving a note in the incident timeline and handing post-incident followup to @alice for a short RCA. Suggest closing PD if monitoring stays green.

alice: I can own the postmortem tomorrow, will check autoscaler logs and routing policy commit. Mark resolved after 30m stable window.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: incident P12345 resolved by bob at 1719810150. Closing incident thread.
